newsitem.title: USA: Mich. voters approve $517.49 mln of school bonds.
newsitem.headline: Mich. voters approve $517.49 mln of school bonds.

text.p: Michigan school district residents passed 18 bond referendums totalling $517.485 million under the state's school bond loan program this week, the Michigan Department of Treasury's School Bond Loan Section reported.
Residents rejected another 13 requests for debt issuance under the program as well in voting Monday, the department reported.
Referendums were approved in the following districts:
*$57.65 million for Clarkston Community Schools.
*$13.7 million in two issues for Durand Area Schools.
*$7.69 million for Kent City Community Schools.
*$79.18 million in two issues for L'Anse Creuse Public Schools.
*$3.96 million for Mason City Central School District.
*$11.855 million in two issues for Montague Area Public Schools.
*$61.5 million for Northville Public Schools.
*$11.575 million for Ornsted Community Schools.
*$7.135 million for Pewamo-Westphalia Community Schools.
*$7.985 million for Port Huron Area Schools.
*$100.575 million for Rochester Community School District.
*$66.5 million for Rockford Public Schools.
*$9.805 million for Springport Public Schools.
*$6.9 million for Swan Valley School District.
*$71.475 million for Troy School District.
Residents rejected 13 bond referendums totalling $170.07 million in the following districts:
*$6.955 million for Harbor Beach Community Schools.
*$30.535 million in two issues for Manistee Area Public Schools.
*$1.22 million for Morrice Area Schools.
*$12.565 million for Ovid-Elsie Area Schools.
*$3.75 million for Pewamo-Westphalia Community Schools.
*$10.995 million in two issues for Rochester Community School District.
*$12.99 million for Saugatuck Public Schools.
*$68.61 million for Southgate Community School District.
*$6.415 for Unuion City Community Schools.
*$750,000 for Walkerville Rural Community Schools.
*$19.285 million for West Branch-Rose City Area Schools.
((--David Bailey, Chicago Newsroom, 312-408-8647))
